scenes.heading: Benefits of Delta Lake
scenes.narration: Delta Lake brings warehouse-grade reliability to the data lake, which is why so many teams standardize their tables on it.

scenes.heading: Key benefits
bullets: Time travel for auditing and recovery
scenes.narration: ACID transactions prevent readers from ever seeing partial or corrupt data during writes. Time travel lets you audit history or recover from a bad update by querying an earlier version. Schema evolution lets tables adapt as your data changes. And one Delta table can serve both batch and streaming workloads at once.

scenes.heading: Plain files vs. Delta
scenes.narration: With plain Parquet or CSV files, a failed write can leave readers with corrupt or partial data. Delta guarantees full ACID behavior so reads are always consistent. It also unlocks operations like time travel and MERGE that raw files simply cannot offer.

scenes.text: Delta Lake gives you the reliability of a warehouse with the flexibility and scale of a data lake.
scenes.narration: The bottom line is that Delta Lake gives you the reliability of a warehouse with the flexibility and scale of a data lake.
